name: Blue Moon
source: The music loving hero that lives by the rule of "not performing in front of others" meets a ghost who has lost her memory. During the search, the ghost falls in love with him and eventually finds out the truth of her own death. "Words" are collected throughout the story. For the final performance you will choose which words to use for your song. What do you want to convey? To who? Your words change the ending! A youth love story.
translation: 热爱音乐的主人公一直恪守“不在人前演奏”的原则，却遇见了一位失去记忆的幽灵。在寻找记忆的过程中，幽灵爱上了他，也逐渐查明了自己死亡的真相。故事中，玩家会收集各种“词语”，并在最后的演出中，选择将哪些词语写进歌曲。你想传达什么？又想传达给谁？你选择的词语，将改变故事的结局！一段青春恋爱故事就此展开。
